concl.text:
Strengths
• Freehold tenure, with an entry price from about RM399,000 for 700–1,000 sq ft units in an established Ampang locality.
• Mah Sing is a listed, experienced developer, and the facility list is broad, including co-working space, sky deck and sports courts.
• Ampang has mature surroundings with existing LRT Ampang Line service and public hospital access somewhere in the wider area.

Things to consider
• The completion target is 2033, a long horizon. Delivery dates, pricing and specifications may change before handover.
• Maintenance fees and bedroom configurations are not yet disclosed, and exact walking distance to rail stations is unverified.
• Ampang roads can be congested at peak hours, and high-rise supply in the area should be weighed against rental and resale demand.

May suit
Buyers with a long time horizon who want a freehold high-rise in Ampang, accept construction-period uncertainty, and can verify exact transit and school distances independently.

concl.text:
Strengths
• Kepong location with MRT Putrajaya Line and KTM stations within a few kilometres, plus Jalan Kuching and MRR2 access.
• Established mature neighbourhood: AEON Metro Prima, Brem Mall, Kepong Metropolitan Park and Desa ParkCity amenities nearby.
• Entry pricing from about RM350,000 for 700–1,000 sqft three to four bedroom layouts; low 33 sen psf maintenance indicated.

Things to consider
• Leasehold tenure and 2026 target completion; construction timelines and final delivery dates can shift.
• Kepong and surrounding corridors have substantial new high-rise supply, which may weigh on resale and rental yields.
• Peak-hour congestion on Jalan Kepong, Jalan Kuching and MRR2; stations are a drive or feeder ride away, not walkable.

May suit
Likely suited to owner-occupiers and first-time buyers wanting an affordably priced family-sized unit in a mature northern Kuala Lumpur suburb, provided they are comfortable with leasehold title, construction risk and competition from nearby new supply. Buyers should verify the exact address, distances and specifications directly with the developer.

concl.text:
Strengths
• Established Setapak neighbourhood with malls, schools, TAR UMT nearby and multiple LRT stations within a few kilometres.
• Road access via Jalan Genting Klang, MRR2, DUKE and SPE toward KLCC and the city fringe.
• Entry pricing from ~RM380k and low stated maintenance of RM0.36 psf for a new condo.

Things to consider
• Leasehold tenure and 2030 completion mean a long wait and resale value depends on remaining lease.
• Not walking distance to LRT; Jalan Genting Klang and MRR2 traffic is often heavy at peak hours.
• Setapak already has many condos and student-driven rentals, so competition on rental and resale is possible.

May suit
Owner-occupiers or longer-term investors comfortable with leasehold, a 2030 handover and an area already well supplied with condominiums.
